A_durablePersistence.problem: Launch-critical Journey progress, onboarding, chapter state, and Lumina conversation/memory lived in .data/ file stores and would not survive Vercel serverless or Postgres restore.
A_durablePersistence.fix: lib/durable/{db,schema,documents}.ts — tagged-template SQL, schema ensure, hosted-production fail-closed. Stores select supabase_postgres vs file_local_development vs unconfigured_production.
A_durablePersistence.auth: Production already uses Postgres via getAuthStore when POSTGRES_URL is set — not changed to file.
A_durablePersistence.billing: Stripe is SoR. Postgres is projection/cache. Isolated restore does not cover Stripe ledger.
A_durablePersistence.backup: CRITICAL_PUBLIC_TABLES includes new bh_* tables. Isolated restore uses in-memory PGlite. Hosted probe: GET /api/fab-5/aos/backup-probe (authorizeHeartbeatRequest / CRON_SECRET).
A_durablePersistence.gap: This Cloud Agent has no POSTGRES_URL. Production WAL and live logical export were not obtained. Do not fabricate WAL evidence. Row 181 cannot be ACCEPTANCE_READY.

B_rateLimits.problem: Login/register/support/analytics lacked durable IP+account limits; in-process is not enough on Vercel.
B_rateLimits.fix: lib/rate-limit/consume.ts + http.ts backed by bh_rate_limits (Postgres) or local file. Wired on login, register, support, analytics ingest, marketing session.
B_rateLimits.lockout: 8 failed logins / 15 minutes; response remains invalid_credentials.

C_blueprint.problem: Per-request Puppeteer --no-sandbox on Vercel (F-12 / 300s Chrome) is unsafe and unscalable.
C_blueprint.fix: Print HTML Architect path; hosted Chrome launch fail-closed; no --no-sandbox in production serverless.
C_blueprint.qaOpen: BLUEPRINT_QA_OPEN not turned on by this branch.

D_smtp.problem: Unbounded SMTP connect could hang serverless.
D_smtp.fix: connectionTimeout/greetingTimeout 10000, socketTimeout 15000 preserved/present on this branch.
